# Phase Three — Thirty Further Corrections

The Awtsmoos is beyond first plan and second plan; Awtsmoos.com lets the third light expose where elegance could accidentally become invention.

1. `_awtsmoos.profile.js` is already 136 lines; touching it requires modular split, never comment shaving.
2. Prefer a focused relationship route module composed into profile routes.
3. Preserve every existing profile route key.
4. Verify more-specific status routing does not conflict with `/follows/:alias`.
5. Encode frontend path segments.
6. Normalize again on server.
7. Keep status read public unless current graph policy says otherwise.
8. Do not use Social Kernel follows yet.
9. Do not infer mutuality.
10. Do not add badges to People without batch support.
11. Do not reload hidden Network gratuitously.
12. No new DB keys.
13. No storage migration.
14. No event bus.
15. No optimistic relationship cache.
16. Keep mutation response compatibility.
17. Keep list response compatibility.
18. Keep target notification metadata semantics.
19. Keep follow count caps.
20. Point status returns boolean plus normalized target only.
21. Search external helper imports before deleting old scanner utility.
22. Preserve exported helper if outside callers exist.
23. Give every rewritten function full JSDoc.
24. Replace compressed touched callbacks with named functions.
25. Keep tests below 120 by shared witnesses, never compression.
26. Run syntax before behavioral tests.
27. Run full Social baseline after focused tests.
28. Reread every touched file.
29. Update REMAINING_WORK and docs.
30. Continue into discovery/search cancellation once this edge is closed.
